stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para Brasília (DF): dia de sol com aumento de nuvens a partir da tarde; não chove

en.title: Weather forecast today for Brasília (DF): sunny day with increasing clouds from the afternoon; no rain
en.summary: Brasília is expected to experience sunny conditions with increasing cloud cover in the afternoon on Saturday, with no precipitation. High temperatures of 34°C and lows of 19°C are forecast.

stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para São Paulo (SP): sol e aumento de nuvens de manhã; pancadas de chuva à tarde e à noite

en.title: Weather forecast today for São Paulo (SP): sun and increasing clouds in the morning; rain showers in the afternoon and evening
en.summary: São Paulo will experience sunny conditions with increasing clouds in the morning, followed by rain showers and thunderstorms in the afternoon and evening. Highs of 31°C and lows of 17°C are expected.

stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para São Bernardo do Campo (SP): sol com muitas nuvens; pancadas de chuva à tarde e à noite

en.title: Weather forecast today for São Bernardo do Campo (SP): sunny with many clouds; rain showers in the afternoon and evening
en.summary: São Bernardo do Campo will see sunshine with abundant cloud cover, with rain showers and thunderstorms expected in the afternoon and evening. High temperatures of 30°C and lows of 20°C.

stories.title: Previsão do tempo hoje para Santo André (SP): sol o dia todo; muitas nuvens e pancadas de chuva de manhã e à noite

en.title: Weather forecast today for Santo André (SP): sunny all day; many clouds and rain showers in the morning and evening
en.summary: Santo André is forecast to be sunny throughout the day with heavy clouds and rain showers in the morning and evening. Temperatures will reach highs of 30°C and lows of 19°C.

stories.title: Ex-presidente José Sarney é internado após dores e procedimento abdominal

en.title: Former President José Sarney admitted to hospital after abdominal pain and procedure
en.summary: Former Brazilian president José Sarney, 96, was admitted to intensive care at a hospital in São Luís on Friday after experiencing abdominal pain.

stories.title: Kassio baixa regra para acelerar análise de ações de propaganda no TSE após críticas

en.title: Kassio establishes rules to expedite analysis of campaign advertising cases at TSE following criticism
en.summary: The TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques implemented new procedures to accelerate the judgment of electoral advertising and right of response cases in the weeks before the second electoral round.

stories.title: Segundo turno tem guerra judicial com ordens de ministros contra Lula e ação do PT contra Flávio

en.title: Second round features judicial battle with ministerial orders against Lula and PT action against Flávio
en.summary: The first week of campaigning for the presidential second round concluded amid high-temperature judicial disputes at the TSE between the two rival campaigns.

stories.title: TSE manda suspender site que oferece criptomoedas por apoio a Flávio

en.title: TSE orders suspension of website offering cryptocurrency in exchange for support for Flávio
en.summary: Brazil's electoral tribunal ordered the suspension of a website that was providing cryptocurrency to users who posted messages supporting presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, determining it offered illicit economic advantage.

stories.title: Ministra do TSE manda tirar do ar site com esquema de criptomoedas pró-Flávio

en.title: TSE minister orders removal of cryptocurrency site with scheme supporting Flávio
en.summary: A TSE minister ordered the takedown of a cryptocurrency sales website hosting a scheme that distributed tokens to users who shared messages and content promoting presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Após disparada de até 50%, ações de saúde e educação ainda têm fôlego para subir?

en.title: After surges of up to 50%, do health and education stocks still have room to rise?
en.summary: Health and education company stocks rose sharply during the week, with Ânima leading gains. An investment bank assessed the impact of falling interest rates on potential further increases.

stories.title: Ex-presidente José Sarney é internado na UTI após procedimento abdominal

en.title: Former president José Sarney is admitted to ICU following abdominal procedure
en.summary: Former president José Sarney was admitted to intensive care following an abdominal medical procedure.

stories.title: Lula zera impostos sobre a gasolina a duas semanas do segundo turno

en.title: Lula eliminates gasoline taxes two weeks before presidential runoff
en.summary: The Lula government announced temporary elimination of gasoline taxes two weeks before the presidential election runoff vote.

stories.title: Kassio baixa regra para acelerar análise de ações de propaganda no TSE após críticas

en.title: Kassio lowers rule to accelerate analysis of electoral propaganda actions at TSE after criticism
en.summary: The president of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court issued new rules to speed up judgment of electoral advertising cases ahead of the October 25 runoff election. The measures follow concerns about delayed decisions and concentrated power among court leadership.

stories.title: Anitta declara voto em Lula e critica Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Anitta declares vote for Lula and criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Singer Anitta announced her support for presidential candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the October 25 runoff, criticizing Bolsonaro's movement and acknowledging she underestimated its electoral strength.

stories.title: Furacão Simon ganha força na costa do Pacífico do México e ameaça região turística

en.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens off Mexico's Pacific coast and threatens tourist region
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified off Mexico's Pacific coast with sustained winds of 177 km/h and is expected to reach Category 4 strength by Saturday, threatening popular beach resorts and fishing villages in the southwestern and central-western regions.

stories.title: Motiva registra alta no tráfego de veículos em setembro

en.title: Motiva records high vehicle traffic in September
en.summary: Motiva reported 126.1 million vehicles on its highways in September, marking a 30.8% increase from the same month last year. On a comparable basis excluding certain concessions, traffic increased 1.2% annually.

stories.title: Justiça Federal suspende decisão que autorizava funcionamento de bet apesar de MP proibitiva

en.title: Federal Court Suspends Decision Authorizing Betting Operations Despite Prohibitive Measure
en.summary: A federal appeals court president suspended a lower court ruling that had allowed Stake Brazil to continue online betting operations until October 25, despite a provisional measure that permanently banned betting companies in Brazil. The suspension followed a request from the government's legal office.
